mapper.insert: insert into raffle_activity_order(user_id, sku, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, total_count, day_count, month_count, state) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sku}, #{activityId}, #{activityName}, #{strategyId}, #{orderId}, #{orderTime}, #{totalCount}, #{dayCount}, #{monthCount}, #{state})
mapper.select: select user_id, sku, activity_id, activity_name, strategy_id, order_id, order_time, total_count, day_count, month_count, state from raffle_activity_order where user_id = #{userId}
